logline: Deep in the misty forest, Alexander confronts an injured Juliana and uncovers the wound inflicted by Lady Catherine, reacting with fury and protective concern upon learning that someone is systematically poisoning the Dowager Duchess with arsenic.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately following Juliana's ordeal at Ashburg Manor, where she escaped punishment after hiding the antidote and now encounters Alexander awaiting her on the woodland trail.

blocks.text: Wide tracking shot through a dense, sun-dappled forest as mist curls around towering tree trunks and tangled roots.
Juliana walks hurriedly along the leaf-strewn forest path, clutching her dark hooded cloak tightly around her shoulders, breathing heavily.
Medium low-angle shot panning up as Alexander emerges from behind a moss-covered tree, blocking the trail.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Juliana."
Close-up of Juliana stopping abruptly, her expression guarded and weary.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Why are you walking like that?"
Medium close-up of Juliana clutching the collar of her cloak with trembling fingers.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "I am tired. That is all."
Alexander steps forward and reaches out, his gloved hand firmly grasping her left shoulder. Juliana winces sharply and gasps in sudden pain.
Two-shot profile of Alexander grabbing Juliana's shoulder as she recoils.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "You're hurt."
Close-up of Juliana gritting her teeth against the pain, shaking her head.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "It is nothing."
Alexander's gloved fingers pull back the torn fabric of her cloak and sleeve, revealing a raw, bloody welt slashing across her bare shoulder.
Tight close-up of the fresh riding-crop laceration cut across Juliana's shoulder.
Close-up of Alexander's scarred face darkening with volatile fury, his jaw tightening.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Who did this?"
Medium close-up of Juliana averting her eyes, her head bowed in quiet resignation.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "It does not matter."
Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes burning with intense anger.
Alexander steps directly into her space, firmly taking her hand in his.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Who?"
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes, whispering the truth.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Lady Catherine."
Close-up of Alexander, his gaze piercing and hard.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Where did you meet her?"
Close-up of Juliana recounting the incident.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "I was in the wrong chamber. I was punished as a maid."
Close-up of Alexander, pressing her without hesitation.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "What were you doing there?"
Medium two-shot of Alexander leaning down toward her against the dim forest backdrop.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Juliana... why were you inside Ashburg Manor?"
Close-up of Juliana holding his gaze resolutely.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "I went there to help someone."

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Who?"
Medium close-up profile of both of them locked in stillness.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "The Dowager Duchess."
Tight close-up of Alexander's face freezing in shock, his eyes widening as the revelation hits him.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "The Dowager?"
Medium profile tracking shot as Juliana begins walking slowly along the trail, Alexander following closely by her side.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Prudence told me she was dying."
Medium close-up of Juliana turning toward him, recounting the scene in the bedchamber.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "She was barely breathing when I found her. The doctor said she was simply growing old."
Two-shot as Juliana stops and looks up into Alexander's grim expression.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "But it wasn't age."
Medium shot of Alexander staring down at her, waiting for the dark truth.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "What did you find?"
Tight close-up on Juliana's trembling lips.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Poison."
Slightly wider close-up as Juliana's eyes well with distress.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Arsenic."
Alexander's hand drops to his side and clenches into a white-knuckled fist, the thick scar across his hand tightening with intense restraint.
Close-up on Alexander's fist clenching tightly in fury.
Medium close-up of Juliana, her voice filled with mounting dread.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Someone has been giving it to her again and again. Small amounts. Enough to make her weaker without killing her quickly."
Close-up of Alexander processing the sinister calculation behind the poisoning.
Two-shot as Juliana looks up at him with quiet hope.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "I made her medicine. She was still barely conscious, but her breathing became easier."
Close-up of Alexander's startled gaze.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "You treated her?"

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Yes."
Close-up profile of the two facing each other.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Alone?"

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "With Prudence."
Close-up of Alexander, his brow furrowed with deep protective worry.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Will you be going there again?"
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes filled with resolute purpose.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "I have to."
Juliana places her gentle hand against Alexander's broad chest, trying to soothe his rising anger.
Two-shot of Juliana leaning in, her hand resting over Alexander's coat.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "She is still sick. I cannot leave her there."
Alexander takes both of her hands into his own, gripping them tightly.
Medium two-shot of Alexander holding Juliana's hands in the dusky woods.
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his darkened face with questioning concern.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Alexander... why are you so angry?"
Close-up of Alexander speaking through clenched teeth, barely containing his protective fury.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Because you were standing inside a house where someone is poisoning a woman... and you never told me."
Medium shot of Juliana looking down sheepishly before raising her eyes.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "I knew you would worry."
Tight close-up of Alexander, his voice trembling with terrified passion.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Worry? They struck you. They could have killed you."
Two-shot as Juliana looks up into his eyes, holding firm.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "But they didn't."
Close-up of their clasped hands, panning up to Alexander's tormented gaze.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "This time."

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "I am being careful."
Two-shot as Juliana looks at him earnestly.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "I cannot abandon her."
Alexander closes his eyes for a brief, agonizing second, exhaling deeply as he yields to her unshakeable conviction.
Close-up of Alexander opening his piercing eyes, resignation and steadfast devotion washing over his features.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Then tell me everything."
Medium two-shot as Alexander holds her gaze in the twilight shadows.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Everything you saw."
Alexander turns, falling into step beside Juliana. Together, side by side, they begin their quiet walk down the darkening forest path into the twilight.
Wide tracking shot from behind Alexander and Juliana as their silhouettes disappear into the shadowy, mist-veiled forest as emotional strings swell to a resolving chord.
